Check Title: Exact package versions can be traced to affected products
Threat Scenarios: SUPPLY-CHAIN-INCIDENT-UNKNOWN-BLAST-RADIUS: 汚染dependency発覚時に使用repository、build、artifact、credentialを特定できず、containmentと復旧が遅延する。; SUPPLY-CHAIN-RESPONSE-EVIDENCE-LOSS: 証跡保全前のcache削除やcredential失効、未承認の破壊的対応により調査可能性または可用性が損なわれる。; SUPPLY-CHAIN-RUNTIME-INVENTORY-GAP: SBOM対象artifactとactive deploymentのdigest関係が欠落し、稼働している影響serviceとenvironmentがincident scopeから漏れる。
Threat Actor or Source: compromised dependency maintainer or attacker introducing a malicious exact package version
Row Attack or Failure Scenario: responders know the package version but cannot identify affected repositories builds and artifacts
Why This Check Is Required: exact reverse lookup converts a dependency alert into an actionable and bounded incident scope
Required State: repository build and artifact impact is queryable
Expected Result: an exact package version returns all linked repositories builds and artifacts
